class.name: InputActionMapping
class.brief_description: A named action and its bindings in one Input Action Map.
class.description: Use the same [InputAction] definition in several mappings. Each mapping supplies its own logical ID and physical binding slots. Scripts read the mapping ID through [Controls].

method.name: add_binding
method.description: Appends a binding in authoring order and returns this mapping. Call [method validate] to check the draft.

method.name: validate
method.description: Returns [constant OK] if the ID, action and bindings are valid. Invalid values return [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER]. A duplicate binding ID returns [constant ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS].

members.member: Reusable definition of the value produced by this mapping and whether it requires pointer capture.
Physical sources in authoring order. An empty array leaves this action available at its neutral value.
Stable logical ID used by gameplay scripts and [Controls]. Use a nonempty ID unique across the whole layout.
